name: Ekadashi
caption:
Ekadashi sirf ek tithi nahi — ek devi hai! 🙏
Sote hue Vishnu ko bachane ke liye unke shareer se ek kanya prakat hui, aur daitya Mur ka ant kar diya. Padma Puran ki katha, is Utpanna Ekadashi par.

Comment mein 'Jai Shri Hari' likhein aur apnon ke saath share karein 🙏

#ekadashi #utpannaekadashi #vishnu #sanatandharma #hindumythology #kaalchitra
title: Ekadashi ek devi hai? Utpanna Ekadashi ki asli katha | Padma Puran
